decisions.reason: A safety shoe line is core business for this large footwear maker, and with only one year of evidence and ample slack there is no shortfall to trigger problemistic search.
A comfort insole is a low-cost complement that supports shoe sales, but it gets only a mention and overlaps with other insoles, so consolidation is a modest risk.
The supportive insole fits the foot-measurement and tailored-solution offer, though its overlap with the comfort insole and the flagship moulded insole makes it the likeliest candidate for pruning.
The ergonomic series has its own page and matches the firm's innovation direction, signalling commitment that management would keep while results are still forming.
Firefighter and rescue boots serve a stable, certification-driven niche with long buying cycles, so slack lets the firm carry them beyond a single year.
As the home-page flagship, the moulded insole carries strong strategic commitment, and management would not judge it against aspirations so soon.
